title: Pre-deployment checklist: before you take a bot live
items: Backtest covers ≥2 years and ≥1,000 trades on out-of-sample data
Kill criteria are written down: max daily loss, max drawdown, broker-condition triggers
VPS is co-located with the broker and latency is measured under 50ms
News freeze configured: 15–30 min around NFP, CPI, and central-bank releases
Position sizing matches account size (Fixed-1% or Half Kelly, never Full Kelly)
Backtest slippage and spread assumptions match live broker conditions ±20%
Logging captures every order, fill, partial, and reject with timestamps
A weekly review reminder is on the calendar
